newsitem.title: USA: Clevetrust Realty votes to liquidate.
newsitem.headline: Clevetrust Realty votes to liquidate.

text.p: CleveTrust Realty Investors said on Tuesday that its board voted to liquidate.
The company said the ability of the trust to attract new capital is limited due to the trust's asset size, the geographic spread of its investments and the different type of properties.
Liquidation would take place over the next three years, but the board will consider merger proposals or the sale of all of its properties in a single deal, CleveTrust said.
The distribution to shareholders should range between $5.00 to $6.50 a share, CleveTrust said.
